name: Sbu Clean
status: built; 1.0 rejected 14/10 (4.3), Resolution Center reply pending

replaces.name: Cleanup: Phone Storage Cleaner
replaces.price_model: free download, deletion behind a weekly subscription

one_thing: Frees space in Photos, one decision at a time, and ends on the space freed.

features.name: Swipe keep/delete
features.description: Month by month, Recent, Random; buttons Tieni, Elimina, Indietro equivalent to the gesture, VoiceOver actions.
features.reason: Core of both originals; locked by daily limits.

features.name: Duplicates and similar
features.description: Vision feature prints on device; best photo suggested (favourite, edited, face quality, sharpness), preselected but never deleted without the bin review.

features.name: Screenshots and videos by size
features.description: Smart album and PHAssetResource fileSize; every video plays before deciding.
features.reason: Paid in Cleanup; pain: videos deleted blind.

features.name: Bin review
features.description: All marked items reviewed in one place; delete only through PHPhotoLibrary.shared().performChanges { PHAssetChangeRequest.deleteAssets } so iOS shows its own confirmation; no other deletion path exists in the code (Apps/SbuClean/SbuClean/Library/PhotoKitLibrary.swift).
features.reason: Pain: wrong deletions; Apple requires the system dialog anyway.

features.name: Recently Deleted explained
features.description: After deletion: 'Le foto restano 30 giorni in Eliminati di recente' and how to get the space now.
features.reason: Pain: space that doesn't come back.

features.name: Stable progress
features.description: Decisions stored by PhotoKit local identifier, survive updates.

features.name: Limited Photos access
features.description: Works on the selected subset, says so in a row, offers presentLimitedLibraryPicker; never nags.
features.reason: iOS 14+ limited access is common; the space figure must say it counts only the visible photos.

tool_screen.caption: Spazio liberabile
tool_screen.figure: bytes you can free, ByteCountFormatStyle(.file), statHero, closed by SbuFullStop in accent-clean
tool_screen.context: after deletion: space freed, with the Recently Deleted note

flows.name: Onboarding
steps: One screen with the promise and Inizia
Photos permission asked on Inizia (full or limited)
Tool screen with the space figure as soon as the scan of sizes ends

flows.name: Permission denied
steps: Explains why, button to Settings, no dead end

network: No server and no account. An iCloud original is downloaded by PhotoKit only when the user asks to watch or compress it: say 'nessun server', not 'zero rete'.

review_risks.risk: Rejected 14/10 in the lot of six.
review_risks.mitigation: Resolution Center reply; if refused, resubmit alone in slot 2 with the differences from Apple Photos Duplicates in the notes.
Purpose string says what is read and that nothing leaves the iPhone; limited access fully supported.

launch_assets.screenshots_for_press: 3 Sbu screens only (tool screen, list or bin, settings with the promises); never the Originale's icon or screenshots on the site
launch_assets.video: 20 s vertical 1080x1920, same file on Reels, Shorts and TikTok, from a simulator screen recording (marketing/<slug>/video.md)
launch_assets.trademark_line: <Originale> è un marchio del rispettivo proprietario; Sbu non è affiliata.
